verdict.rationale: Terraform is an infrastructure-as-code CLI/tool, not an AI agent or assistant with a tool-calling loop that would consume external MCP servers; the evidence pack instead shows Terraform publishing its OWN MCP server (terraform-docs-10, terraform-probe-4, terraform-probe-9) so that external AI agents can call Terraform's tools — the opposite direction from this client-side story. This axis is a category mismatch for a declarative infra tool, not an applicable-but-unmet capability.
